newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Cash white wheat bids up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Cash white wheat bids up.

text.p: Cash soft white wheat bids jumped on Wednesday, bolstered by news that Pakistan bought U.S. soft white wheat, dealers said.
"The Pakistan sale helped us," one Oregon merchandiser said.
Pakistan overnight bought 282,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat and 47,000 tonnes of Australian wheat, a Pakistani embassy official said. Shipment was slated for May 20-June 10.
Spring wheat bids were mixed as dealers noted that farmers were focusing on spring wheat seedings in parts of Montana, Minnesota and the Dakotas.
Farmers were busy planting spring wheat and barley with very little movement seen, a Montana dealer said.
